description: A reference client implementation for the playback of MPEG DASH via Javascript and compliant browsers.

latest_release.name: dash.js v5.3.0
latest_release.body:
## Features
- Live latency calculation for L3D-DASH streams by @dsilhavy in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5103
- CMCD: support for custom keys via the new setting `streaming.cmcd.customKeys` by @sebastian-siepe in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5114
- CMCD: upgraded to CML cmcd 2.8.2 by @littlespex in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5168
- Improved language matching for track selection by @stschr and @dsilhavy in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5153, https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5179

## Bug Fixes
- Gaps that exist in only one track (e.g. video only) are now jumped, and buffering behind them is capped instead of buffering the rest of the content, by @robertbryer and @dsilhavy in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5184
- CTA-608 captions are now rendered correctly, with no merged or dropped captions and correct column alignment, by @tobbee in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5078
- CEA-608 captions now respect `presentationTimeOffset` on the embedding video AdaptationSet by @bbert in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5126
- SegmentBase segment lists are now loaded only for the selected Representation by @pkosmala in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5137
- All Preselection representations are now checked for capability support by @PascalThuet in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5123
- Guard the timeline reads and the non-ISOBMFF path against crashes by @mormegil6 in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5104
- Manifest parsing no longer mutates Roles and Representation properties, and preserves Viewpoint arrays, descriptor values and date-like string attributes, by @PascalThuet in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5084, https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Fohttps://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5083, #5139 
- Restored two reported BCP-47 track language values by @PascalThuet in #5120
- CMCD: msd is now computed as the time between the starting and playing states by@sebastian-siepe in #5110
- CMCD: error codes (ec) are now reported once per report destination by @sebastian-siepe and @dsilhavy in #5169
- CMCD: fixed the include in request filter by @dsilhavy in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5171 
- CMSD data is no longer added to the HttpList metric by @dsilhavy in #5182  
- resourceTiming.responseStart now uses the performance.now() clock by @sebastian-siepe in #5173
- Additional fixes from findings in the functional test suite by @dsilhavy in #5188
- Dependency audit fixes by @dsilhavy in #5170 , #5189

## Refactoring
- Refactoring of `MediaPlayer.js`, moving logic into dedicated modules, by @dsilhavy in #5144 
- Extracted range calculations from `BufferController` by @PascalThuet in #5074
- Centralized the `CustomParametersModel` callback registry logic and descriptor materialization
by @PascalThuet in #5075, #5080

## Samples and Reference Player
- The reference UI now keeps the ine copied URL and on reload by@dsilhavy in #5181 
- The default timesync URL example now uses https in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5155  

## Build, CI and Tests
* Additional test vectors added to the smoke test list by dsilhavy in  https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5180
* PR workflow runs the tests on Chrome by @dsilhavy in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5176
* CI, documentation and issue template maintenance by @dsilhavy and @vaibhav8a in https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5108, https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5166, https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5174, https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/pull/5118

detail.readme:
## Overview dash.js is a JavaScript based implementation for the playback of MPEG DASH content in browser based environments that support the [Media Source Extensions](https://w3c.github.io/media-source/) and the [Encrypted Media Extensions](https://www.w3.org/TR/encrypted-media/). ## Documentation To get started, check out our [documentation](https://dashif.org/dash.js/) that includes a [quickstart guide](https://dashif.org/dash.js/pages/quickstart/index.html) , [usage instructions](https://dashif.org/dash.js/pages/usage/index.html) and [contribution guidelines](https://dashif.org/dash.js/pages/developers/how-to-contribute.html). ## Hosted Examples * [Reference Player](https://reference.dashif.org/dash.js/latest/samples/dash-if-reference-player/index.html) * [Samples](https://reference.dashif.org/dash.js/latest/samples/index.html) ## Quickstart A very basic example on how to use dash.js in your application can be found below: ```html dash.js Rocks
``` ## Contact Please raise any issue directly on [Github](https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/issues). You can also find us on [Slack!](https://join.slack.com/t/dashif/shared_invite/zt-egme869x-JH~UPUuLoKJB26fw7wj3Gg) and on [Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/dashjs). ## License dash.js is released under [BSD license](https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js/blob/development/LICENSE.md) ## Tested With [](https://www.browserstack.com/)    [](https://www.lambdatest.com/)
